name: @gears-frontx/frontx-template-inbox
description: Contributes a workspace product to a repository that already has an application shell: four microfrontend screens built from @gears-frontx/ui-kit - contacts (a filterable directory and each person's page), dashboard (KPI cards, charts, workload and recent activity), chat (channels, conversations, a reply-and-note composer and a link to the contact's page) and mail (mailboxes, a reading pane, reply and compose) - each with its own Module Federation build, route tree inside the shell's screen domain, UI strings and mocked @gears-frontx/api services. Contacts, dashboard and chat answer from one page-wide inbox mock store; mail keeps its own. Apply this onto template-shell; the screens appear in the shell's menu without further wiring.
